verdict.rationale: WooCommerce's own docs describe native webhooks that send automatic event notifications to a URL of your choice, configured to trigger on store events. That is a registrable outbound HTTP callback a programmatic consumer can receive. The evidence is only a short first-party description, with no detail on how delivery works. missing for 10: list of supported event topics, payload signing/verification and retry behavior, programmatic (REST API) webhook registration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Webhooks let your WooCommerce store send automatic event notifications to a URL of your choice.
You (or your developer) can configure a webhook that is triggered by events on one site
